Feature: MCP Server & Brain Query Layer  [id: c03233e5-6a19-44fd-a5f5-3d4ccd3351f5]

Understanding: The MCP server predated the spec that proposed building one, with a sophisticated file-based implementation reading from .repo/ alongside an online REST implementation querying the DB directly — two complementary approaches coexisting. [s:3977fef3] The Brain API was discovered to be 'two APIs in a trenchcoat' — four tools speaking the retired Topic ontology and three speaking Feature from Postgres with no shared ids — which was resolved by unifying entirely around Feature keys in the v1.1 contract, with Topic tools and proposeKnowledgeDelta removed. [s:348dbc5a] MCP-to-session correlation uses explicit stamping (tools take an optional sessionId and the server stamps it), and no MCP call was emitting activity events until instrumentation was added, meaning Brain was previously blind to its own usage. [s:348dbc5a]

Constraints:
  · The Topic ontology is retired; the Brain API contract unifies entirely around Feature keys.
  · Topic tools and proposeKnowledgeDelta are removed.
  · MCP-to-session correlation uses explicit sessionId stamping, not heuristics.
  · Every MCP tool call must emit an activity event for observability.
  · Task resolution must never silently guess on fuzzy matches — the 'never guesses' PRD promise must be honored.
